category.description:
Used to find its Federated Module in the corresponding mapping.

'core' means it is part of the c3ui_core Federated Module
'all' means any Federated Module can contain it

moduleName.description:
The name of the ESM module this file represents. Default: file.fileNameNoExt().

This is used to find the containing federated module in combination with the category.

title:
Represents a metadata file that contains code or other metadata for the UI.

Used in UiSdlMetadataLoader as a wrapper for the files that are generated by it.
name: UiSdlMetadataFile
